// One row: `strategy: 'horizontal'`, and the tabs stay on it (`axis: 'x'`). `animateChanges`
// slides the others when a button opens or closes a tab, which no drag did.
const { items } = makeSortableList(strip, { items: tabs, strategy: 'horizontal', axis: 'x', animateChanges: true });

let next = 5;
const open = () => {
  const tab = { id: next++, title: 'New tab', hue: (next * 47) % 360 };
  tabs.value.push(tab);
  activeId.value = tab.id;
};
const close = (id: number) => {
  const index = tabs.value.findIndex((tab) => tab.id === id);
  tabs.value.splice(index, 1);
  if (id === activeId.value) activeId.value = (tabs.value[index] ?? tabs.value[index - 1])?.id ?? 0;
};

          @select="activeId = tab.id"

<script setup lang="ts">

const props = defineProps<{ person: { id: string; name: string; hue: number } }>();
const el = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('el');

<script setup lang="ts">
import { toRef, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableList } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import PersonCell from './PersonCell.vue';

type Person = { id: string; name: string; hue: number };
const props = defineProps<{ column: { id: string; title: string; people: Person[] }; placeholder: 'item' | 'indicator' }>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ swap: [text: string] }>();

const list = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('list');
// `behavior: 'swap'`: the dragged person trades places with the one under it, and the
// others stay put. Both columns swap and share a group, so they swap with each other too.
const { items } = makeSortableList(list, {
  id: props.column.id,
  items: toRef(props.column, 'people'),
  group: 'rotation',
  behavior: 'swap',
  placeholder: () => props.placeholder,
  onDrop: (e) => {
    if (e.partner) emit('swap', `${e.items[0]?.name} ⇄ ${e.partner.item.name}`);
  },
});
</script>

<template>
  <section class="rotation">
    <h4>{{ column.title }}</h4>
    <ul ref="list" class="people">
      <PersonCell v-for="person in items" :key="person.id" :person="person" />
    </ul>
  </section>
</template>
